claim: Het Zoute is the chic eastern district of Knokke-Heist, defined by authentic villas, vast golf courses, top restaurants and high-end boutiques.
quote: Het Zoute exudes style: from the authentic villas and vast golf courses to the best restaurants and high-end boutiques. A district for lovers of the good life.

claim: Kustlaan is the most exclusive shopping street of Knokke-Heist where designer brands have storefronts, while Lippenslaan is the broader retail strip.
quote: Kustlaan is the most exclusive shopping street of Knokke-Heist and perhaps even Belgium, where all the designer brands like to have a storefront.

claim: Knokke Casino's circular Magritte Room holds 'The Enchanted Domain', a 360-degree panoramic mural of eight panels completed by René Magritte in 1953, roughly 70 m long and 7 m high.
quote: A subsequent renovation allowed surrealist master Magritte to create a giant 360° mural, finished in 1953, comprising eight panels called The Enchanted Domain.

claim: A full renovation of the Knokke casino building is planned to begin in early 2026, with grand reopening targeted for 2032 — relevant to current visit access.
quote: Construction work will begin in early 2026, with a complete renovation and transformation of the current casino building planned for early 2029, and a grand reopening expected in 2032.

claim: Heist beach is quieter and more local than Knokke's main strip — gentler waves, fewer tourists, sleepier rhythm, suited to families and walkers.
quote: Heist Beach is where locals with strollers and sand toys go, with no frills, fewer tourists, gentler waves, and a slightly sleepier rhythm.

claim: Zeebrugge combines a working world port with a seaside town; the busy port activities next to the wide beach create an atmosphere unique on the Belgian coast.
quote: The presence of all those busy port activities near the wide beach creates a unique atmosphere and makes Zeebrugge a special oddity on the Belgian coast.

claim: The standard Zeebrugge harbour cruise lasts 75 minutes and passes the naval base, gas terminal, breakwater wind turbines, tern island and one of the world's largest sea locks.
quote: The standard cruise through the outer harbour of Zeebrugge lasts 75 minutes. You'll admire the Belgian naval base, the gas terminal, wind turbines on the breakwater, the tern island, and one of the largest sea locks in the world.

claim: Seafront Zeebrugge is a maritime experience site built around the historic fish auction with fishmonger shops, artisan chocolatiers and unique stores.
quote: In and around the Fish auction site and Seafront, you'll discover local specialist shops such as fishmongers, artisanal chocolatiers and unique shops.

claim: Sea Life Blankenberge houses over 2,500 marine creatures across habitats from the Amazon to the North Sea and runs Belgium's only seal rehabilitation centre.
quote: Home to over 2,500 creatures from around the globe, featuring diverse marine habitats from the Amazon to the North Sea... Belgium's only seal rehabilitation center.

claim: Blankenberge is positioned as a family beach resort with shallow play zones, a historic pier symbol of the coast, and a cosier, livelier atmosphere than Knokke's polish.
quote: Blankenberge is one of the most popular seaside resorts on the Belgian coast, offering a perfect combination of beach fun, a cosy atmosphere, and a variety of activities for all ages.

claim: De Haan is a Belle Époque seaside resort with low-rise Anglo-Norman villas and winding lanes — a deliberate absence of high-rises sets it apart from neighbouring towns.
quote: Architecturally renowned for its well-preserved Belle Époque style, characterized by low-rise villas, winding lanes, and an absence of the high-rise concrete blocks found in many neighboring coastal towns.

claim: Albert Einstein took refuge in De Haan in spring 1933, arriving by tram with 17 suitcases of books, staying on Shakespearelaan before emigrating to the US; a statue commemorates him.
quote: In spring 1933, Albert Einstein stepped off the tram with 17 suitcases full of books, seeking refuge from the political upheaval in Germany, and stayed for a few months on Shakespearelaan.

claim: The James Ensor House at Vlaanderenstraat 29 reopened in 2020 as an experience centre — the artist's original home plus five interactive rooms with his masks, letters and studio.
quote: You can bring his paintings to life, explore his personal belongings and carnival masks, browse through his letters and photos, and finally take a peek inside his authentic living and working space.

claim: Mu.ZEE in Ostend is a contemporary museum of Belgian art from 1850 onward, holding works by Ensor, Spilliaert, Permeke, Tuymans, Fabre, Magritte, Delvaux and Panamarenko.
quote: Mu.ZEE is a contemporary museum in Oostende, Belgium that showcases Belgian artwork from 1850 to the present, featuring works by renowned artists such as James Ensor, Leon Spilliaert, Constant Permeke, Luc Tuymans, Jan Fabre, Rene Magritte, Paul Delvaux.

claim: The three-masted Mercator was Belgium's merchant-marine training ship from 1932 to 1960 and has been moored as a floating museum in Ostend's marina, in front of city hall, since 1964.
quote: In 1961, she became a floating museum, first in Antwerp and, from 1964, in the marina of Ostend, just in front of the city hall.

claim: The Kusttram is a single De Lijn line running 67 km from De Panne via Ostend to Knokke-Heist with around 65 stops — the world's longest tram line — full end-to-end takes about 2.5 hours.
quote: This tram line stretches over 67 kilometers, making it the world's longest tram line. With over 65 stops, it connects the entire coastline, from Knokke-Heist in the north to De Panne in the south.

claim: Kusttram day pass is €9 adult / €4.50 child for 24h unlimited; runs every 10–20 minutes by day, every 30 minutes evenings, with later evening service in summer 2026.
quote: The day pass is €9 per adult and €4.50 per child for unlimited travel for 24 hours along the entire coast. In summer 2026, trams will run later in the evening.

claim: Approximate distances from Knokke: Zeebrugge ~10 km, Blankenberge ~11 km, De Haan ~20 km midpoint between Blankenberge and Ostend, Ostend ~27 km as the crow flies.
quote: The shortest distance between Knokke and Blankenberge is 6.98 mi (11.23 km)... the geographic midpoint between Blankenberge and Ostend is located in De Haan.
